crossRefs.note: When he was at the place, he said to them, “Pray that you don’t enter into temptation.”
“So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day…
Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.
So the ship master came to him, and said to him, “What do you mean, sleeper? Arise, call on your God! Maybe your God…

parallels.note: Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

translations.web: and said to them, “Why do you sleep? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation.”
translations.bsb: “Why are you sleeping?” He asked. “Get up and pray so that you will not enter into temptation.”
translations.kjv: And said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.
translations.asv: and said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, that ye enter not into temptation.
